purpose.zh: 练臀部，让腿往后推更有力
purpose.en: Build your glutes for pushing your leg back.

text.zh: 用臀部把腿往后推，身体不动
text.en: Use your glutes to push the leg back and keep your body still

text.zh: 弹力带固定在前方低处，椅子只用来扶稳。
text.en: Anchor the band low in front of you; use the chair only for balance.
Keep your lower back from arching and return slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 用腰往后弯代替臀部发力
commonErrors.en: Arching your lower back instead of using your glutes.

cautions.zh: 第一次先做一组轻松的 6 次
cautions.en: The first time, do just one easy set of 6.

cautions.zh: 别把弹力带绑在椅子上
cautions.en: Never tie the band to the chair.

changes: 名字去掉「髋后伸 / Hip Extension」术语，改「后抬腿 / Leg Kickback」
主口令去掉「骨盆和躯干」两个指令，口令按 0.7 s 相位缩短
flags: 改了动作名，请确认是否接受
